data.translation_aya_text: Demi matahari dan sinarnya pada pagi hari,
data.translation_en: CONSIDER the sun and its radiant brightness,
and the moon as it reflects the sun!
Consider the day as it reveals the world,
and the night as it veils it darkly!
Consider the sky and its wondrous make,
and the earth and all its expanse!
Consider the human self, and how it is formed in accordance with what it is meant to be,

data.translation_aya_text: maka Dia mengilhamkan kepadanya (jalan) kejahatan dan ketakwaannya,
data.translation_en: and how it is imbued with moral failings as well as with consciousness of God!

data.translation_aya_text: sungguh beruntung orang yang menyucikannya (jiwa itu),
data.translation_en: To a happy state shall indeed attain he who causes this [self] to grow in purity,

data.translation_aya_text: dan sungguh rugi orang yang mengotorinya.
data.translation_en: and truly lost is he who buries it [in darkness].

data.translation_aya_text: (Kaum) samud telah mendustakan (rasulnya) karena mereka melampaui batas (zalim),
data.translation_en: TO [THIS] TRUTH gave the lie, in their overweening arrogance, [the tribe of] Thamud,

data.translation_aya_text: ketika bangkit orang yang paling celaka di antara mereka,
data.translation_en: when that most hapless wretch from among them rushed forward [to commit his evil deed],

data.aya_text: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُوْلُ اللّٰهِ نَاقَةَ اللّٰهِ وَسُقْيٰهَاۗ
data.translation_aya_text: lalu Rasul Allah (Saleh) berkata kepada mereka, “(Biarkanlah) unta betina dari Allah ini dengan minumannya.”
data.translation_en: although God's apostle had told them, "It is a she-camel belonging to God, so let her drink [and do her no harm]!"

data.aya_text: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَعَقَرُوْهَاۖ فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْۢبِهِمْ فَسَوّٰىهَاۖ
data.translation_aya_text: Namun mereka mendustakannya dan menyembelihnya, karena itu Tuhan membinasakan mereka karena dosanya, lalu diratakan-Nya (dengan tanah),
data.translation_en: But they gave him the lie, and cruelly slaughtered her - whereupon their Sustainer visited them with utter destruction for this their sin, destroying them all alike:

data.translation_aya_text: dan Dia tidak takut terhadap akibatnya.
data.translation_en: for none [of them] had any fear of what might befall them.
